{{Quote|The Quermian was an outsider. He was a friend to our family for many years&mdash;but he couldn't change what he was.|Sith Lord Vilia Calimondra, on Ayanos Bactra|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
'''Ayanos Bactra''' was a [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who ruled a [[Bactranate|region]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. While most of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] neighbors [[Second Charge Matrica|waged war]] against each other, Bactra avoided battles and established himself as an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]], using corporations as a means by which he could expand his influence.

In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Bactra made a deal with the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], whereby he would supply Daiman with an [[arxeum]]&mdash;a type of mobile [[University/Legends|university]] dedicated to the study of war sciences&mdash;in return for Daiman allowing him access to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Vellas Pavo]], which was competing with Bactra in the production of the superconductor [[Gadolinium]]. Bactra subsequently traveled to the planet [[Gazzari]] with a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and handed over an [[Daiman's arxeum|arxeum]] to [[Daimanate|Daiman's forces]], and he observed from afar a [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] that [[Ground warfare/Legends|took place]] on the world between Daiman and the [[Odionate|armies]] of his brother [[Odion]]. However, during the fighting, the brothers' grandmother [[Vilia Calimondra]] sent a message to Daiman and Odion, ordering them to turn on Bactra. The two siblings sent their forces to [[Invasion of the Bactranate|attack]] the Quermian's holdings, and within a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Bactra's empire had fallen.

==Biography==
{{Quote|An arxeum is the answer. I require one&mdash;delivered.''"<br />"''I require passage across your territory to strike at Vellas Pavo. Temporary; we do not intend to hold the world. Six weeks should suffice.|Daiman and Ayanos Bactra|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
Ayanos Bactra was a [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as the ruler of the [[Bactranate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], and established a [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jutrand]], on the [[Duros Space Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> In [[1040 BBY]],<ref name="Note">The [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'' novel]] is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and the novel states that [[Chagras]] [[Death/Legends|died]] eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events portrayed in the book, thus placing his death in [[1040 BBY]].</ref> the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Chagras]], the heir to the [[Vilia Calimondra's empire|holdings]] of the powerful Sith Lord [[Vilia Calimondra]], [[Death/Legends|died]]. As a result, a [[Second Charge Matrica|conflict]] broke out between Calimondra's grandchildren, who competed against each other for the right to become Calimondra's new heir. Viewing the contention as an opportunity, Bactra began [[Arms dealer/Legends|selling arms]] to all sides.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Later in the war, Bactra [[Conquest of Sarrassia|conquered]]<ref name="Escape 2">[[Knight Errant: Escape 2|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 2]]</ref> the world [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]], and in order to protect the planet's deposits of the metal [[Sarrassian iron/Legends|Sarrassian iron]], he ended a conflict on the world between followers of the [[Grumani]] and [[Spumani]] religions.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

[[File:Bactranate.png|thumb|right|200px|The Bactranate]]
By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Bactra was considered to be aged, and had entered a deal with the Sith Lord [[Daiman]], a grandson of Calimondra, to grant [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of [[Industrial Heuristics]]&mdash;one of the Quermian's companies&mdash;permission to carry out recruitment operations within Daiman's [[Daimanate|territories]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Around that time, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] compiled a report on the state of affairs in the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and, in it, he detailed all of the information that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] possessed on the subject of Bactra and the Bactranate.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

Following the [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|destruction]] of a [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility|Daimanite testing center]] on the planet [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], Bactra contacted Daiman on a priority communications channel. Daiman explained to the Quermian the details of the attack, and Bactra claimed to have no prior knowledge of the strike, or any recognition of [[Narsk Ka'hane]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who was partially responsible for the loss of the research facility. In order to resolve the temporary weakness in the Daimanite defenses created by the loss of the testing center, Daiman requested that Bactra supply him with an [[arxeum]], a mobile [[University/Legends|university]] devoted to the development of war sciences. Bactra agreed to the proposition, promising to hand over an [[Daiman's arxeum|arxeum]] to Daiman on the world [[Gazzari]], in return for Bactranite forces being granted passage across Daimanite [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to the world [[Vellas Pavo]], for six [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. Vellas Pavo was the site of [[Mining/Legends|mines]] extracting the superconductor [[Gadolinium]], which were competing with Bactra's own superconductor interests, and Daiman's [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Uleeta]], believed that Bactra planned to destroy the Vellas Pavo facilities.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

[[File:Vilia_Calimondra.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Vilia Calimondra, the Sith Lord who ordered the seizure of Bactra's empire]]
Bactra traveled to Gazzari with a small [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] and relinquished an arxeum to Daiman's forces. Shortly afterward, a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by Daiman's brother, [[Odion]], arrived in the [[Gazzari system/Legends|system]], intent on [[Battle of Gazzari|attacking]] Daiman's forces and their newly acquired arxeum. After sighting Bactra's fleet, Odion contacted the Quermian, and Bactra informed him that the deal with Daiman had taken place and that the Bactranites were no longer concerned with the fate of the arxeum. Bactra and his fleet then remained in the Gazzari [[Star system/Legends|system]], observing the battle between the Daimanites and the [[Odionate|Odionites]] from afar. However, Vilia Calimondra had decided that her family no longer needed Bactra, and, during the battle, Narsk Ka'hane sent a message from Calimondra to Daiman and Odion, that ordered them to turn on the Quermian Sith Lord. The two siblings subsequently sent their forces to [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]] Bactra's fleet, destroying half of the Quermian's forces in the Gazzari system.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

The remnants of Bactra's fleet jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and fled to Jutrand. However, the Daimanite and Odionite forces [[Invasion of the Bactranate|pursued]] them, and, within a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Bactra's empire had fallen to Daiman, Odion, and the Sith [[Lioko]] and [[Malakite]]. Vilia [[Bequest|divided]] Bactra's corporate assets up among her grandchildren<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> with Odion receiving custody of several of Bactra's [[Accountant/Legends|accountants]].<ref name="Escape 1">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref> Vilia's granddaughter, [[Arkadia Calimondra]], claimed to have received information that Bactra had gone into hiding in a Quermian retirement colony.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Wretched little trader.|The Sith Lord Odion, on Ayanos Bactra|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
Ayanos Bactra was a strategist and one of the cleverer Sith Lords who operated in the Grumani sector.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> While most of his Sith contemporaries [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] populations and dissolved corporations, Bactra instead viewed his subjects as assets,<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> and he ensured that the Bactranate served as a safe haven for companies that had fled from contested worlds. He went out of his way to avoid fighting battles against rival Sith states,<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> instead using companies as a means by which he could expand his influence in regions that he could not gain control of by military means.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

He openly and equally sold arms to all of the various Sith factions in the Grumani sector, because he realized that supplying weaponry secretly would earn him the enmity of the other Sith, since they would expect an arms dealer to supply all sides. Vilia Calimondra considered Bactra to be a friend of her family, but her grandchild Odion publicly displayed a dislike for the Quermian. Bactra also believed that members of the Bothan [[Species/Legends|species]] had a tendency to meddle in matters that were above them.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ayanos Bactra was first mentioned in [[The Knight Errant Gazetteer|The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer]], an article that was written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[John Jackson Miller]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[November]] [[2010]], serving as a tie-in to the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> The character was later featured in the [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'' novel]], which was written by Miller and released in [[January]] [[2011]],<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> and also received minor mentions in [[2012]] in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Escape|''Escape'']] arc of the ''Knight Errant'' comic series.<ref name="Escape 1" /><ref name="Escape 2" /> Though Bactra is noted to use he/him prouns,<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> none of the sources confirm his gender.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /><ref name="Knight Errant novel" />
